name: plugin.perfetto_trace_processor
description: Google Perfetto Trace Processor plugin: trace file loading, SQL querying against sched/slice tables, performance metric calculation, and flame graph export.

entrypoints.name: perfetto_load_trace
entrypoints.description: Load and parse a system trace file (.perfetto-trace, .pftrace, Chrome/Android trace)

parameters.name: trace_path
parameters.description: File path to the trace file

parameters.name: verbose
parameters.description: Enable verbose trace descriptor ingestion logs

entrypoints.name: perfetto_query_sql
entrypoints.description: Execute arbitrary SQL queries against trace tables (e.g. 'SELECT name, dur, ts FROM slice')

parameters.name: trace_id
parameters.description: Active trace identifier returned from perfetto_load_trace

parameters.name: sql_query
parameters.description: SQL statement targeting Perfetto schema tables

entrypoints.name: perfetto_compute_metrics
entrypoints.description: Compute standard trace metric summaries (CPU scheduling latency, thread execution times)

entrypoints.name: perfetto_export_flamegraph
entrypoints.description: Produce structured execution stacks and flame graph summaries from trace slices

parameters.name: focus_thread
parameters.description: Optional thread or process name to filter execution stacks
